# METADATA.md — Quiet Wild (test fixture)

Publishing language for this channel. Style and boundaries, never copy.

## Title style

Species and habitat led, calm and factual. Vary structure across uploads.

## Description voice

Patient, observational third person. What lives here, what the viewer watches, the season if verified.

## Keyword usage

Species names, habitat names, the words people use for calm animal watching.

## Tags

Six to twelve: species, habitat, region if verified, format, use.

## Hashtags

Two to four: species and habitat.

## Call to action

One line at most.

## Location naming

Region or biome; a named reserve only when verified from the footage licence.

## Factual claims

No behaviour claims that were not seen in the footage. No conservation statistics without a source.
